title: Maximum Number of Operations With the Same Score I
summary: Given an array of integers, repeatedly remove the first two elements and calculate their sum as the score.
statement: Given an array of integers, repeatedly remove the first two elements and calculate their sum as the score. Continue until fewer than two elements remain, ensuring all operations have the same score. Determine the maximum number of such operations.
constraints: Each operation removes the first two remaining elements.
The first removed pair establishes a score equal to its sum.
Continue while every later removed pair has the same score; return the maximum operation count.
hints: After each front removal, the next operation always uses the next two original positions.
Store the sum of indices zero and one.
Scan disjoint consecutive pairs until one differs, counting matches.
The forced removal order leaves no alternative choices, so the first mismatch ends every valid continuation.
editorial: The forced removal order leaves no alternative choices, so the first mismatch ends every valid continuation.

tests.explanation: The pairs 3+2 and 1+4 both score five; one value remains, so two operations succeed.
The second pair scores seven rather than five, so only one operation succeeds.
